summary: L-6 cab on a 60-foot pole tower, built 1934 on the Nez Perce National Forest and destroyed in 1957. No source describes remains.

facts.design: L-6 cab on a 60-foot pole tower
facts.status_note: Tower destroyed in 1957; no source describes what remains at the site

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in; a National Geodetic Survey station description dated 1946 gives trail directions from the end of truck travel

events.note: L-6 cab on a 60-foot pole tower, about 1/4 mile southeast of the highest point
Tower destroyed; no cause given in the sources

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 1934 build and 1957 destruction, and the design and height match the brief. No staffing source (Idaho Fire Lookouts says no staffing history is documented), so staffing is omitted. No source describes remains or current access. The NGS station description is dated 1946 on the page, so its trail directions may be out of date. The story gives that date, and a visitor should check before relying on the directions.
